cards.title: Hidden Power
cards.instruction: Act publicly modest while making choices as though you control the outcome.

cards.title: Recognize Me
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge your importance, expertise, or authority.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm only the person washing the pans, but could you thank the cook before I bring the wedding cake out?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Everyone knows you made the food.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The programme thanks 'the buffet'. I'll have the band hold off until you've put a name to it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely. I'll bring the cake in just after my surname. Say it slowly, please; I'd hate the band to come back in before you've finished.
